title: Negotiated Outcomes and Clean Exits
keyConcepts: negotiate while advancing: press the attack while keeping a sincere settlement channel open
face-saving exit as load-bearing infrastructure, not courtesy
the exit discipline: pre-commit to exit conditions before the campaign begins
honoring the pre-committed exit against psychological pressure to continue
sunk-cost reasoning, public commitment, and personal identification as exit obstacles
credibility as the shared structural requirement of both strategies
connectingThread: Both strategies depend on credibility. The negotiating channel works only if the exit offer is sincere. The exit discipline works only if the pre-committed conditions are honored. The operator's future strategic capacity rests on whether stated positions can be trusted.
reversalFlags: fake exit offer discovered → opponent fights to the end, leverage lost
publicly named exit condition not honored → credibility damaged for all future negotiations
exit conditions can be misleading → persistence may be correct, but the judgment is biased by sunk-cost psychology
callbackOpportunities: Ch3 Choosing Not to Fight: defensive cousin of exit discipline
Ch5 The Long View: grand strategy gives meaning to the exit
Ch7 Indirection: negotiating channel as a form of indirect maneuvering
moralFlagNote: The ethical line is whether the exit is real or simulated. Sincere exit offer = legitimate paired pressure. Fake exit offer = manipulation that poisons future negotiations once discovered.
